message: Aha! Now there's an interesting class marker of its own, Dennis: .pdfs indicating a different readership; likely one more familiar with "print" conventions, and therefore without as much of a need to be up on current technologies, indicating an administrative job? Well, there's the [recent post](http://kairosnews.org/node/view/2474) at Kairosnews mentioning the fact that Tony Blair promised to get himself an email account. Tech-savvy people are more likely to be worker bees?
